verdict.rationale: Lever is an ATS with a public developer API, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for it. The pack shows only conventional human-oriented API documentation (endpoints, webhooks, OAuth, sandbox). Nothing in it mentions llms.txt, markdown docs for LLMs, or any documentation built for agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
